# Boss Tire — Tire Shop, Wheel Alignment & Muffler Repair in Scarborough

> Boss Tire is an independent tire and auto-repair shop at 375 Danforth Rd, Unit 8,
> Scarborough, Ontario. It serves Scarborough and the Greater Toronto Area with new and
> used tires, seasonal tire changeovers, wheel alignment, muffler & exhaust work, oil
> changes, and related services — with published, up-front prices and same-day service
> while you wait. Rated 4.8/5 across 321 Google reviews. Phone: (647) 871-2393.

## Business facts

- Name: Boss Tire
- Address: 375 Danforth Rd, Unit 8, Scarborough, ON M1L 3X8, Canada
- Phone: (647) 871-2393
- Email: info@boss-tire.ca
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Area served: Scarborough and the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario
- Google rating: 4.8 out of 5 (321 reviews)
- Same-day service; most jobs done while you wait
- Publishes its prices (many Scarborough competitors do not)

## Services and published prices (CAD, before tax)

- New & used tires — sales, mounting and balancing
- Tire Changeover — $60 (seasonal swap, e.g. winter/summer)
- Winter tire changeover — seasonal specialty, book ahead in fall
- Tire Rebalancing — $12 per tire
- Tire Bolt-On (wheels off/on, torqued) — $50
- Tire Storage — $110
- Wheel Alignment — $80
- Rim Repair & Bend Repair — $120
- Oil Change — $60.99
- TPMS (tire pressure monitor) service — $69.99
- Caliper Painting (all four, common colours) — $240
- Muffler Repair & Replacement — from $160 (varies by vehicle)
- Exhaust Repair — from $150

- To book or get a quote, call (647) 871-2393 or use the contact form at
  https://boss-tire.ca/contact — the shop confirms exact pricing by vehicle.
- Prices above are the shop's published starting prices, excluding tax; muffler and
  exhaust pricing varies by vehicle.
- Boss Tire is a physical local shop in Scarborough, not a national chain or online store.
